TSA estimates that it will take 30 minutes (0.5 hours) to complete and submit the forms, which results in an estimated burden of 3,750 hours. TSA estimates that of the 900 claims approved each year, TSA will ask only two claimants per year to complete TSA Form 600.  TSA estimates the time to complete TSA Form 600 is 2.5 minutes.  As the usage of the form is rare, TSA estimates the burden to be de minimis.

provenance.original: TSA estimates that each electronic submission (via emails and online tool) takes 5 minutes (0.083 hours) for a contractor and 30 seconds (0.0083 hours) for a federal employee to review.  The federal employee takes less time because he or she is only looking at the TSA Comment Card to determine if it contains a security threat.  The contractor (TCC agent) takes more time because the review process involves reading the electronic submission, selecting the appropriate template response, and sending it back to the passenger.  TSA multiplies 245,878 average annual responses by 0.083 hours to obtain an estimated annual burden of 20,490 hours, then multiplies that amount by a wage rate of $36.64 to get the annual contractor cost for electronic submissions.  TSA multiplies 245,878 average annual responses by 0.0083 hours to obtain an annual burden estimate of 2,049 hours, then multiplies that amount by a wage rate of $75.98 to get the annual cost for federal government employees. Table 5 shows the TSA hour burden costs for electronic submissions.

provenance.original: TSA estimates that each electronic submission (via emails and online tool) takes 5 minutes (0.083 hours) for a contractor and 30 seconds (0.0083 hours) for a federal employee to review.  The federal employee takes less time because he or she is only looking at the TSA Comment Card to determine if it contains a security threat.  The contractor (TCC agent) takes more time because the review process involves reading the electronic submission, selecting the appropriate template response, and sending it back to the passenger.  TSA multiplies 245,878 average annual responses by 0.083 hours to obtain an estimated annual burden of 20,490 hours, then multiplies that amount by a wage rate of $36.64 to get the annual contractor cost for electronic submissions.  TSA multiplies 245,878 average annual responses by 0.0083 hours to obtain an annual burden estimate of 2,049 hours, then multiplies that amount by a wage rate of $75.98 to get the annual cost for federal government employees.
